title: Scope is the design
description: Deciding what not to build is the highest-leverage act in the whole project. Everything after it is execution. We spend the first week there and we do not rush it.

title: Ship weekly or you are guessing
description: A design that has never been deployed is a hypothesis. From week two you get a real URL every Friday, because opinions about screenshots are worth very little.

title: Small team, whole problem
description: Handoffs are where intent goes to die. The same four or five people carry a project from the first conversation to the launch post, and they hold every part of it.

title: Leave it better than a handover
description: The end of an engagement should not be a cliff. Documented decisions, a codebase your team can read, and a month of availability afterwards for the questions that only show up later.
